verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਬੇਦ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬਿਰੰਚ ਬਿਆਸ ਨੇਿਤ ਨੇਤਿ ਨੇਤਿ ਸੁਕ ਸੇਖ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਇਓ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: si(n)mirat puraan bedh saasatr bira(n)ch biaas nit net net suk sekh jas gaio hai ||

en.bdb: All the 31 Simritis, 18 Puranas, 4 Vedas, 6 Shastras, Brahma the scholar of Vedas, sage Vyas, supreme scholar Sukdev and Shesh Nag of thousand tongues sing the praises of the Lord but have not been able to fathom Him. They address Him as infinite, infinite ...

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਉ ਸਨਕਾਦਿ ਨਾਰਦਾਦਿਕ ਰਿਖੀਸੁਰਾਦਿ ਸੁਰ ਨਰ ਨਾਥ ਜੋਗ ਧਿਆਨ ਮੈ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: siau sanakaadh naaradhaadhik rikheesuraadh sur nar naath jog dhiaan mai na aaio hai ||

en.bdb: Shiv, four sons of Brahma, Narad and other sages, gods, men of substance, nine heads of Jogis could not perceive God in their contemplation and meditation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗਿਰਿ ਤਰ ਤੀਰਥ ਗਵਨ ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ ਬ੍ਰਤ ਹੋਮ ਜਗ ਭੋਗ ਨਈਬੇਦ ਕੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: gir tar teerath gavan pu(n)n dhaan brat hom jag bhog nieebedh kai na paio hai ||

en.bdb: They could not realise that infinite Lord even by roaming in jungles, mountains and places of pilgrimage, making charity, fasting, doing hom-yag and offering food and other delicacies to the gods.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਸ ਵਡ ਭਾਗਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਧਿ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰ ਰੂਪ ਹੁਇ ਦਿਖਾਇਓ ਹੈ ॥੫੪੩॥
verses.translit_en: as vadd bhaag maiaa madh gursikhan kau pooran braham gur roop hui dhikhaio hai ||543||

en.bdb: Such fortunate and enjoying the worldly maya are the Sikhs of the Guru who are seeing the inaccessible Lord in the manifested state of a True Guru.  (543)
